record.name: Platform
record.purpose: The standards this group works to.

says: A person binds this device's key and the checkout, registers the repository's memory source, and founds a Team of their own with a memory source of its own. The owner reads records 12 to 18 of one session transcript. A capture whose single input states that its source permits processing by a named model provider, no prompt log and results committed to this repository is run by that provider with no prompt kept and stored as a draft for the repository's memory source: every contributing input permits the processing, the log and the destination it is used for. Three captures of the same bytes are not made. One sends to the provider a span whose source permits only local processing; it has no spelling and is refused at admission, whatever was redacted or read. One keeps the provider's prompt in a log although the input permits none; the owner refuses it with input_not_permitted. One commits the span to the Team's source although its input permits only this repository as a destination; the owner refuses it with input_not_permitted and no Team receives anything. None of them writes, sends or logs anything.
